  "memo":"Only R04 holds: this is a newly opened account's first attempt, with an amount above the category percentile reference. R04 is Context, not an adverse family. All Account access, Card, Velocity and Linkage conditions are absent; household exceptions are unnecessary. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no checks have run. A legitimate new customer is more plausible than never-pay, which the purchase size alone cannot establish. No installments are due, so non-payment cannot support action. Clear under FP-2 §6.6(c); no verification check is warranted."
